tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Retrieves client case studies and engineering projects. Supports optional search query (by company name or topic) and limit parameter.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Retrieves detailed architecture, technical deliverables, and impact metrics for a specific client case study by company slug.

tools.name: get_testimonials
tools.description: Retrieves verified client reviews, leadership testimonials, and stakeholder endorsements with author names, roles, and review quotes.

tools.name: list_contact
tools.description: Retrieves verified contact channels, email address, LinkedIn profile, timezone, and direct scheduling links.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Searches published technical articles, design system guides, and AI/SEO strategy posts by keyword.

tools.name: get_tools
tools.description: Retrieves developer tools, open-source packages, and AI infrastructure created and maintained by Michael Vereb.

tools.name: get_ai_ui
tools.description: Overview of the AI-UI design system (20 accessible Astro components for AI reasoning, execution pipelines, and streaming chat), package install instructions, and pointer to the dedicated sub-MCP server at https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui/mcp.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_testimonials, list_contact, search_articles, get_ai_ui · Private data: list_contact · Public sink: list_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_testimonials, list_contact, search_articles, get_ai_ui · Private data: list_contact · Public sink: list_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
